source_shape: Tall narrow case with broad shallow trapezoid cap, one upper rectangular-pull drawer and two lower fronts with opposed curved mark patterns, low support rail and two tiny outer feet. Three stacked-front interpretation follows the original glyph, not donor four-drawer layout.

palette.rule: Case/fronts/pull marks are primary. Top cap and tiny feet are source detail. Both roles currently tint identically w; do not invent gold brass rails. Cyan cap/feet are only an extraction aid; final layers must be neutral.

donor_reference.role: Actual installed Dresser_south supplies restrained inset-front wood shading, precise seam edges and low-relief contours. Its four2x2drawers, round knobs, broad footprint, facings and mechanics are not copied.

construction: Three stacked precise wooden fronts: top rectangular recessed pull and opposed lower curved source motifs retained. New parallel cap keeps separate source detail ownership along with tiny feet. Body and hidden-depth assumptions remain explicit; internal brass rails do not become visible gold.
native_state: One fixed source tile,80-weight non-takeable non-solid organic container/inventory furniture with junk inventory builder, non-occlusion and rare Animated builder. No source random, open/closed or empty/full sprite is declared. Native inventory and rare/custom behavior remain native.

frame.rule: One complete source-cell mapping for case/fronts, cap and feet ownership. No independently centered fronts or tiny feet.

native_acceptance: Pending full-set generation gate; native non-solid80-weight/non-takeable organic container/inventory, rare Animated fallback and extra-view placement remain unfinished.

directional_reference.mapping: Actual donor S/N wide frame and E portrait frame rotate render footprint; transparent bounds are not Qud physical dimensions.
directional_reference.role: Parallel rectangular top planes, inset wood surfaces and shallow map-camera visibility only. Retain Qud tall three-front form, not donor low four2x2drawers/knobs or footprint/mechanics.

camera.contract: Straight stacked fronts with parallel rectangular cap; complete end has substantial authored depth. No converging cap edges or yaw. Same16x24source cell/pivot8,16.
camera.depth_status: Authored hidden depth guided by original broad cap and actual directional reference, not native Qud measurements.
camera.front_correction: Preserve existing body/front/pull/foot material and replace only the receding trapezoid cap geometry with a parallel plane. Reuse existing cap material by row-wise surface-coordinate remapping; no separate AI front redraw.
camera.unseen: Plain closed end/back wood with precise seam joinery. No front pulls or hidden brass rails are drawn onto unseen closed faces.
camera.west: Mirror east; symmetric unmarked end and feet.
